changes: Added the initial pack format version of 4.
Added predicates.
Added experimental support for custom world generation.
The /replaceitem command was replaced with /item.
Rolls, set_damage, and possibly other parameters in loot tables now require a valid type field when using min-max for numbers.
score conditions' entity parameter was replaced with target.
Loot tables now require a type field.
Removed length limits for scoreboards, score holders and team names.
The lava_pool_stone_replaceables block tag was renamed to lava_pool_stone_cannot_replace.

The /locate command now takes a configured structure as its first parameter rather than a structure type, so many grouped structures now require you to locate a structure type tag. E.g. /locate village is now /locate #village.
Data pack can have a filter section in pack.mcmeta now.
Renamed the feature field in location predicates to structure.
In 22w19a, /locatebiome was merged with /locate and the syntax for /locate was changed, but the pack format was not updated.
only_allows_snow_and_gold_rabbits biome tag was renamed to spawns_gold_rabbits.
Out-of-bound arguments in translate formats are no longer silently ignored.
Removed specific boolean damage type predicate fields (is_projectile, is_explosion, etc.) in favor of a tags field.
NBT paths for lines of text, GlowingText, and Color on the front of signs are now at front_text.messages[<index>], front_text.has_glowing_text, and front_text.color. Back of signs use back_text.
item_display items rotated 180 degrees around Y axis.
All fields in placed_block, item_used_on_block, and allay_drop_item_on_block triggers collapsed to a single location field.
alternative predicate and loot table conditions renamed to any_of.
Removed entity_roar and entity_shake events for entity_action.
Renamed belowName to below_name in scoreboard slots.
Added macro functions.
Added supported_formats and overlays to pack.mcmeta.
Added /random command.
Changed mob effect storage; effects now use resource locations in NBT instead of numeric IDs.
Tag names relating to effects renamed to snake_case.
Removed /execute if function and /return run functionality temporarily.
Numeric types in macros written without suffixes; precision changes for large/small float/double values.
null and [] are no longer valid JSON chat component representations; stricter parsing of color and hoverEvent fields.
/function result behavior changed; maxCommandChainLength now counts function invocations and execute stages.
Added white_smoke particle.
Renamed Fuse to fuse on TNT entity.
Renamed Trident to item on trident entity.
/return run now propagates fails.
Added breezes and trial spawners.
Added display names and number formatting for scoreboards.
Renamed grass block and item to short_grass.
Added armadillos, wolf armor, and new attributes.
Renamed sweeping enchantment to sweeping_edge.
Added advancement triggers default_block_use and any_block_use.
Added /transfer.
Restricted effect amplifiers (0-127).
Effects in NBT no longer store default values.
Added body_armor_item and body_armor_drop_chance fields to entities.
Replaced horse.armor slot with armor.body.
Amplifiers allowed up to 255 again; certain high amplifiers replaced by attributes.
Block positions NBT changed from X,Y,Z compound to array of 3 integers.
max_depth in /place jigsaw capped at 20.
Unstructured NBT on item stacks replaced with structured components.
Recipe output can now specify components.
Wolf variants and banner patterns are now data-driven.
Removed durability, potions, custom_data, and enchantments fields in item predicates in favor of sub predicates.
Added crafter_recipe_crafted and fall_after_explosion triggers.
Added storage loot number provider.
Added mode field to many loot functions.
Added many new item stack components.
Int and float providers in worldgen are no longer wrapped in an extra value field.
Updated fields and components.
Added new item sub-predicates and loot functions.
Changed the set_fireworks loot function.
Added data driven enchantments and paintings.
Renamed enchantment field to enchantments in item sub predicate.
Renamed legacy tag folders (e.g., tags/items to tags/item).
Replaced power fireball tag with acceleration_power.
Enchantment fields weight and max_level now have upper bounds.
Added data driven jukebox songs.
Renamed folders (e.g., loot_tables to loot_table, tags/functions to tags/function).
Attributes use a single resource location ID field instead of name and UUID.
Added lookup level-based value.
Added liquid_settings to structures.
Added placement modifier fixed_placement.
Renamed replace_disc entity effect type to replace_disk.
Removed attribute ID prefixes like generic..
Goat horn instruments are now data-driven.
Changed food component format.
Added new data components.
Changed trial chamber loot table formats.
Added new sheep loot tables and predicates.
Added equippable, item_model, glider, tooltip_style components and input predicate.
Added loot tables for eggs and scutes.
Added item tags for allays, pandas, and brewing stands.
Added death_protection component.
Renamed killed_by_crossbow to killed_by_arrow.
Added crafting_transmute recipe type.
Split boat types into wood variants.
Lock field and lock component are now item predicates.
Added block_crumble and trail particles.
Added /rotate command.
Renamed enchantment effect damage_item to change_item_damage.
Added disablePlayerMovementCheck gamerule.
Added camera_overlay field to equippable component.
Standardized particle color formats.
Renamed TNTFuse to fuse (Int).
Added duration to trail particle.
Changed format of custom_model_data component.
Removed creaking_transient entity type.
Removed trim_templates item tag.
Renamed furnace timing NBT fields; added lit_total_time.
Text components saved as objects in NBT; commands like /tellraw use SNBT.
Added strict argument to /setblock.
Pig variants are data-driven.
Added weapon and potion_duration_scale components.
Game Tests system accessible via data packs.
Added /test command.
Equipment NBT tags merged into equipment field.
Renamed FallDistance to fall_distance (Double).
Added several components (blocks_attacks, etc.).
Replaced hide_tooltip fields with tooltip_display component.
Cat and frog variants are data-driven.
Added fields to blocks_attacks component.
Cow variants are data-driven.
Chicken variants are data-driven.
Many NBT data changes for entities and block entities.
Data driven sound variants for Wolves.
Added dry_foliage_color field to biomes.
Entity/Block entity NBT and SNBT changes.
New optional predicate fields; SNBT format changes.
Pack format bump missed in pre1. No changes.
Added cloud_height to dimension types.
Particle field renamed to custom_particle.
Added create argument to /datapack.
Added /version.
Added camera_distance and waypoint attributes.
painting/variant component no longer accepts inline variants.
Locator Bar features de-experimentified.
Added home_pos and home_radius tags to mobs.
Unifont updated to 16.0.03.
Added owner NBT tag to vexes and primed TNT.
Added dialog.
Restricted sizes of dialog elements.
Removed certain dialog types.
Added ui sound category.
Added music_disc_lava_chicken item and sound event.
Pack format now includes minor versions for non-breaking changes.
Copper golem weather_state now expects string ID.
Added block_particles field to explode enchantment effect.
Shelf block state replaced by boolean in block entity.
minecraft:profile components resolve differently.
Renamed chain to iron_chain.
World borders are now dimension-specific.
Renamed game rule enableCommandBlocks to commandBlocksEnabled.
Added more sources to copy_name and copy_components loot functions.
Changed syntax of /spawnpoint and /setworldspawn.
Added /stopwatch and execute stopwatch.
Added several new predicate types.
Added environment attributes.
Changed syntax of /stopwatch.
Changed fields of minecraft:filtered loot function.
Added slot sources; renamed all game rules.
minecraft:dynamic loot pool entry change.
Added timelines and more environment attributes.
minecraft:dynamic loot pool entry support reinstated.
Added minecraft:attack_range component.
Added new fields to attack_range component.
Villager trades are now data-driven.
Wolf sound variants moved to adult_sounds; added baby_sounds.
Added world clocks and time markers; changed /time behavior.
Added minecraft:the_end world clock.
Added dye component; recipe types data-driven.
Added has_ender_dragon_fight to dimension types.
Added sound variants to Cats, Pigs, Cows and Chickens.
Changed minecraft:nbt text component behavior.
Added entity subcommand to /fetchprofile.
Added pause_mob_growth and reset_mob_growth particles.
Changed rotation property in banners and signs from 0 to 8.
Added options to number providers and predicates.
Bone meal features data-driven.
Added /time [of <clock>] rate subcommand.
Increased limit of count placement modifier.
